newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B shares end down sharply on heavyweight.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares end down sharply on heavyweight.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index ended sharply down on Wednesday, hit by fears that heavy profit-taking in a newly-listed big A share issue would drag down the domestic index and hit foreign currency B shares, brokers said.
The B index closed at 146.62, down 3.08 points or 2.06 percent on flimsy turnover of HK$40 million, compared with HK$57 million on Tuesday.

The domestic currency A share index slumped 6.11 points or 1.41 percent to 428.29, with giant newcomer First Automobile Works Car Co Ltd soaking up a large amount of funds from the market, brokers said.
